assessments.reasoning: PDF pages 1, 4 and 13 identify SC09-2508-07, V6R1M0 WebSphere Development Studio for iSeries and the RPG IV language as implemented by IBM's ILE RPG compiler on i5/OS. IBM's V6R1 download list points to this exact vendor-hosted manual.

challenge.method: Checked edition markers, RISC applicability, the i5/OS and previous OS/400 names, and the manual's distinct treatment of RPG III conversion. Compared the later IBM i 7.5 reference listing.
challenge.results: The subject is the RPG IV language in the V6R1 IBM compiler and host context. The edition and platform are explicit and the ILE compiler has its own identity.

limitations: The frozen vendor PDF URL was reached directly. A later IBM i 7.5 HTML listing returned HTTP 403 on direct web open. Registry active status is locally assigned.
